title: Options every agent harness takes
description: Composed by each harness addon's options.schema.json, which adds its own keys and rejects unknown ones with unevaluatedProperties: false.

args.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to the agent launch.

effort.description: Reasoning effort the agent runs at.

sandbox.description: Sandbox lists; only valid with permissions: 'sandbox'.

config.description: The agent's own permission configuration; only valid with permissions: 'custom'.

env_deny.description: Environment variables removed from the run environment.
